- Career progression opportunities

title: Contracts Administrator
description:
Contracts Administrator (Part-Time)
- Department: Business Support
- Location: Barnstaple
- Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week
- Salary: £32,000 - £35,000 Pro Rata
- In person / Hybrid

This role offers flexibility, with hours worked across Monday to Friday between 8:00am and 5:00pm. It would suit someone looking for a flexible part-time position that can fit around family commitments, study, or a phased move towards retirement.

The Role

We are looking for a dependable and highly organised Contracts Administrator to join our Business Support team, providing commercial and administrative support across procurement, supplier management and contract administration.

Working closely with colleagues across Technology, Finance and external suppliers, you will play a key role in ensuring purchasing activity is well managed, contract information is maintained accurately, and colleagues have the information they need to make informed commercial decisions.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills and commercial awareness who enjoys working with detail, building effective relationships and supporting business operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Obtain quotations and support day-to-day purchasing activities.
- Maintain the contracts register, ensuring contract information is accurate and up to date.
- Monitor contract renewal dates, commercial terms and supplier commitments, ensuring contract owners are aware of upcoming actions.
- Coordinate procurement activities and supplier administration.
- Support supplier and software licence management.
- Maintain software licence records and assist with compliance activities.
- Coordinate the disposal of IT hardware in line with company processes.
- Monitor and maintain appropriate stock levels of IT hardware to support business requirements.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider team as required.

About You

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining excellent attention to detail.
We're looking for someone with:
- Previous experience in procurement, purchasing, contract administration, supplier coordination, finance administration or a similar administrative support role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workloads effectively.
- Good commercial and financial awareness.
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical, analytical approach.
- The ability to work independently while building strong working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.
- Experience or knowledge of IT asset management processes would be beneficial.
- An understanding of ITIL, particularly Asset Management, Request Fulfilment or Configuration Management, would be advantageous, although not essential.

Previous IT industry experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from candidates with transferable skills gained in other sectors.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary.
- Paid holiday and pension scheme.
- Flexible part-time working pattern across Monday to Friday.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Training and career development opportunities.
- Employee Assistance Programme.
- Retail discount scheme.

If you're looking for a varied administrative role where organisation, attention to detail and commercial awareness are valued, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Recycling Administrator
description:
Job Description Recycling Officer Recycling Administrator

We are seeking motivated and passionate Recycling Officers, ready to hit the ground running, to join our Food Waste Collection Project. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in delivering a high-profile, time-critical service that must be successfully implemented by the end of 2026, with the potential to lead to a permanent position. As a Recycling Officer, you will be the public face of the service, working directly with residents to support the rollout and drive participation.

We are looking for self-starters who are proactive, highly motivated, and results-focused, with strong interpersonal and customer service skills and a passion for environmental issues and behaviour change. While the role is primarily field-based, there is a small office-based element, including use of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, alongside general project support. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible difference in the community while contributing to a major environmental initiative.

Key accountabilities and key measures Recycling Officer Recycling Administrator

Role outcomes Recycling Officer Recycling Administrator
- Customer service delivery to engage with residents and partners. Dealing with Street Scene and Waste issues, consultations, problem solving and identifying any areas which can be developed into a project. (30%)
- Attending schools, promoting the importance of litter collections and environmental initiatives, educating students on all areas, developing environmental projects to enhance the communities and allowing children to take ownership. (20%)
- Liaising with a variety of groups planning events large and small ensuring timescales and Health and Safety requirements are met. (20%)
- Responsible for undertaking enforcement action in collaboration with other enforcement services. (15%)
- Ensuring all PCC Health and Safety standards are adhered to at all times. (5%)
- Overseeing staff and volunteers at events and projects, preparing risk assessments and being responsible for their wellbeing and the safety of the general public at events. (10%)

Role measures Recycling Officer Recycling Administrator
- Voluntary groups add value to core PCC operational standards and functions.
- Customer engagement evidences satisfaction with service and decrease in complaints received.
- Reduction in incidents of Health and Safety. Budgets are monitored to ensure fully utilised to optimise 'spend'.
- Consultations - feedback from stakeholders which ensures an effective and efficient service.

Key activities Recycling Officer Recycling Administrator
- To act as lead officer with community engagement for street scene and waste services. (25%)
- Act as point of contact for the co-ordination of service requests; actions arising from meetings and events such as ward walkabouts and community meetings. (10%)
- Organise events and meetings and ensure they are resourced appropriately, as directed by the manager. (10%)
- Liaise with a large variety of groups and external partners on a range of issues responding independently to provide innovative and collaborative solutions to enhance the service area. (10%)
- Responsible for education projects to provide motivation, raise awareness and engage with children and young people to help them to make a contribution to their environment. (10%)
- Liaising with Councillors, community groups and partners to develop cross cutting projects / initiatives and inventive concepts to enhance the customer experience. (5%)
- Responsible for making daily site visits to ensure that standards of work are maintained as specified. (5%)
- Assisting the operational staff when required to move equipment. (5%)
- To deal with specific management and technical problems including assisting in the maintenance of computer based inventories, records, plans and drawings and notify contractors of changes and variations. (5%)
- To have direct responsibility for supervision and allocation of work for volunteers during the projects and associated works ensuring that PCC Health & Safety guidelines are adhered to at all times. (5%)
- To ensure that project bid budget plans up to the value of £75k are accurately written and monitored. (5%)
- To deal with customer complaints in line with Council policy and procedures ensuring excellent customer care standards are maintained, and undertaking regular research with other organisations to ensure the service is complying with best practice. (5%)
- Ensure customer standards are adhered to at all times.
- Carry out other duties appropriate to the grade of the post.
- Essential qualifications/ knowledge
- 2 GCSE Grade A -C (9-4) in Maths and English or equivalent. Full driving licence.
- Knowledge of budgets and compiling information to support budgetary reports.
- Knowledge of quoting for works to be undertaken.
- Knowledge in the use of Microsoft packages.
- Understanding of the work undertaken by Street Scene & Waste Services.
- Working knowledge of Health & Safety to include completing risk assessments

Desirable qualifications/ knowledge Recycling Officer
- Police and Criminal Evidence Act (PACE) Training

Essential experience
- Proven experience in planning, organising and problem solving.
- Considerable experience of dealing with the public, community groups and volunteers.
- Proven experience of delivering excellent customer care standards to ensure our customers are given a voice; ability to defuse a contentious situation allowing for a successful outcome for all parties concerned.
- Experience of working in an office.
- Limited experience in a supervisory role.
- Experience in Health & Safety Regulations and undertaking risk assessments.

title: Service Receptionist
description: Service ReceptionistKingswear, DevonAre you a highly organised, outgoing individual with excellent customer service skills, strong computer literacy and attention to detail? Could you thrive within a fast-paced team in a professional environment? If so, read on.Who will I be working for?Darthaven Marina is located in the stunning South Hams countryside, surrounded by rolling hills and in a truly tranquil setting. Our impressive 270 berth marina and boatyard have grown over the past 30 years, and we pride ourselves in the first-class service all our teams provide to our berth holders, visitors and customers. You will be working with our teams of Marine Engineers, Marine Electricians, Shipwrights and our Quayside Lifting team.We're currently looking for a Service Receptionist to join us on a full-time basis.What are the benefits?- Salary of £26,000 - £30,000 dependent on experience- Generous holiday entitlement- Pension- Branded company clothing- Stunning working location- On-site parkingThis is a brilliant opportunity for an individual with a great customer focus to join our team providing services for some of the most prestigious boats available.Working in one of the South West's most beautiful settings, you will have the chance to contribute to the day-to-day running of our stunning marina while acting as a key point of contact for customers and staff.What will I be doing?As a Service Receptionist, you will politely greet and articulately assist our service customers and support our Service Team who manage a wide range of duties, often with tight deadlines.You will triage customer requests in person, over the telephone and by email. You will prompt for and accurately record relevant information to enable you to efficiently take messages and route requests to the appropriate service colleague. You will distribute customer requests evenly across the Service Team and gain an awareness of the Service Coordinator role so you may support our team most effectively.Using Sage CRM, you will support our Service Team to raise accurate work instructions. title: Meeting Minutes Administrator
description:
Minute Taker / Business Support Officer
Children & Young People's Services
Location: Plymouth, PL1
Hybrid Working: 75% remote working with a minimum of just 2 office days per month
Hours: 37 hours per week
Pay Rate: 13.90 per hour
Proposed Start Date: 7th September 2026
Assignment: Temporary position running until 31st December 2026
Make a Real Difference Behind the Scenes
Are you an organised administrator with excellent written communication skills and proven minute-taking experience? Do you want a role where your work directly supports the safety and wellbeing of children and young people?
We're recruiting on behalf of our client for a Minute Taker / Business Support Officer to join their dedicated Children & Young People's Services team. This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented administrator to play an important role in supporting statutory meetings that help safeguard and improve outcomes for children, young people and families.
Offering a fantastic hybrid working arrangement, you'll enjoy the flexibility of predominantly working from home while remaining connected to a supportive and experienced team.
Enhanced DBS Required
Why Apply?
Flexible hybrid working with minimal office attendance
Meaningful work that positively impacts children, young people and families
Gain valuable experience within a statutory service environment
Supportive team culture and ongoing learning opportunities
Immediate start available
Competitive hourly rate
What You'll Be Doing
As a key member of the team, you will:
- Produce clear, accurate and professional minutes for statutory Children & Young People's meetings.
- Capture and summarise complex discussions into concise, high-quality records.
- Support Independent Chairs with creating and updating Child Protection Plans.
- Help produce accessible versions of plans for children, young people and families.
- Maintain accurate records of attendees and contact information.
- Ensure confidential and sensitive information is handled securely at all times.
- Update relevant systems and databases with minute-related information.
- Contribute ideas to improve processes and service delivery.
- Provide additional administrative support duties as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential
- GCSE Maths and English (Grade C/4 or above, or equivalent).
- NVQ Level 3 in Business Administration (or equivalent experience).
- Enhanced DBS Required
Due to the nature of this role, an Enhanced DBS check is required. If you already have a valid certificate registered with the DBS Update Service, that's great. If not, don't worry, the cost of obtaining a new DBS certificate will be covered for the successful candidate.
- Previous minute-taking experience.
- Strong grammar, spelling and written communication skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
- Administrative experience within a busy office environment.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong customer service and communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

Desirable
- Experience working within Children's Services or a similar public sector environment.
- Understanding of safeguarding principles and related legislation.
- Knowledge of Children, Young People and Families services.
- Previous business support experience within statutory services.

Skills & Attributes
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
- Outstanding listening and note-taking abilities.
- The ability to identify key information and produce concise summaries.
- Strong time management and prioritisation skills.
- Emotional resilience when attending sensitive meetings.
- Professionalism, discretion and confidentiality.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Additional Responsibilities
The successful candidate will:
- Comply with data protection and information governance requirements.
- Work in accordance with relevant legislation, policies and procedures.
- Promote equality, diversity and inclusion in all aspects of their work.
- Follow Health & Safety policies and safe working practices.

Interested?
If you're looking for a flexible role where your administration and minute-taking skills can genuinely make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today or contact Emily on (phone number removed) for an informal discussion and further information.
Due to the high volume of applications expected, we may not be able to respond to every applicant individually. If you have not heard from us within 14 days of application, please assume you have not been shortlisted on this occasion. We encourage you to continue checking Pertemps for other suitable opportunities.

title: Sales Support Lead
description:
Sales Support Lead
Location: Bideford, Devon
Job Type: Full-time, on-site
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000

Hours: Monday to Friday 8.30am - 5pm
About the Opportunity

We are looking for a friendly, organised and reliable Sales Support Lead to join our team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role, likes working with people and takes pride in keeping things organised and running smoothly.

Working alongside the wider team, you will provide day-to-day administrative and customer support, helping to ensure a positive experience for customers and effective communication across the business.

The Role
The role will involve a variety of administrative and sales support activities, including:
- Responding to customer sales enquiries by telephone and email
- Assisting with the processing and coordination of customer requirements
- Manage and take the lead on complex customer service enquiries
- Keeping information and records accurate and up to date
- Communicating with customers, colleagues and external contacts
- Helping to ensure tasks are followed through efficiently
- Providing general administrative support as required
- Raising purchase orders and processing sales orders with accuracy
- Assisting with the smooth running of the office and wider team

About You
You will be someone who is:
- Organised and able to manage a varied workload effectively
- Confident handling customer enquiries and finding practical solutions
- Able to assess situations, make sensible commercial decisions and take ownership of customer issues
- Calm and resourceful when dealing with more challenging or complex queries
- Thorough, with a strong eye for accuracy and detail
- Responsive and able to prioritise effectively to ensure customers receive timely support
- Adaptable and willing to take a flexible, hands-on approach to your work
- Confident communicating with customers, colleagues and external contacts
- A positive team player who is happy to use initiative and get involved
- Experienced in administration, customer service, sales support or a similar environment
- Comfortable using computers and everyday office systems

Previous experience within a sales or customer service role, preferably within a manufacturing environment would be desired.

What We Offer
- A friendly and supportive working environment
- A varied role with plenty of opportunity to get involved
- Company pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free on-site parking

Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Bideford, Devon.
If you are organised, personable and looking for a varied role within a supportive team, we would love to hear from you.

This vacancy is being advertised by Cooper Golding who are acting as an employment business on behalf of their client.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: ExeterDepartment: FinanceSalary: £28,000 Working hours: Full-time. Hybrid working.

We are supporting a client in Exeter with the recruitment of an Accounts Assistant. This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy finance team during a period of operational change, offering varied exposure across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Master Data. This role would suit a candidate looking for an entry-level role.

About the Role

This role offers broad financial administration experience, with responsibilities rotating in line with business needs. Initially, the focus will be supporting the wider finance team to ensure accurate processing of Accounts Payable activity, including correct coding, invoice matching, and handling supplier queries across multiple international entities.

Key Responsibilities
- Posting purchase ledger invoices
- Matching invoices to purchase orders
- Resolving supplier queries promptly and professionally
- Supporting weekly payment runs
- Assisting the Accounts Receivable team with posting bank transactions
- Providing project and cross-functional support as required

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, or a general finance support role (1 year)
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to manage queries professionally and efficiently
- A proactive attitude with the willingness to learn new systems and processes
- Ability to reliably commute to Exeter is a must

How to apply:

This role is available as soon as the right candidate is found so do not delay. There is plenty of free parking and good access to public transport. The hours are full time only. For more information please contact Stefanie Farber at Butler Rose Finance Recruitment: . Alternatively apply with a full and relevant CV.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.Butler Rose Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
